source.method: Extracted selected source.tar files; SHA256/bytes match frozen site manifest and site bytes. Expected preview/record/restore outputs were produced only by these archived modules.

definition.name: Steady Signal
definition.description: Close one cut through eight distinct interference cells with signal resistance, then win without losing a life.

metadata.title: Copper Orchard
metadata.description: Recommended: Fiber relay. Restore both orchard relays and reveal 72%. Interference slows ordinary radio-linked craft; fiber keeps its speed but its exposed cable can still be hit. A 12-second cut and 36-cell cable budget favor deliberate crossings. The homeward route begins above an orchard at dawn.
metadata.author: Reveal Line
metadata.rightsStatus: Original fictional encounter adapted from the project Fieldcraft teaching layout.

metadata.title: River Switchyard
metadata.description: Recommended: Light carrier, then Heavy carrier at the southern hangar. Refill at a supply pad and use a field to suppress an emitter before crossing. Restore both bridge relays and reveal 68%. Two supply/hangar stops and a 6.5-second cut budget reward a planned route. Other classes can take a slower ordinary line.
metadata.author: Reveal Line
metadata.rightsStatus: Original fictional encounter adapted from the project Fieldcraft teaching layout.

metadata.title: Home Beacon
metadata.description: Recommended: Impact craft. A close pulse can protect an exposed start, abandon that cut and return you home with all lives intact. Then capture the beacon relay and reveal 70% before the 35-second mission limit. Your equipment never captures cells by itself. A careful ordinary route remains possible.
metadata.author: Reveal Line
metadata.rightsStatus: Original fictional encounter adapted from the project Fieldcraft teaching layout.

classRecipes.label: Scout
classRecipes.description: Mark hidden objectives permanently; show enemy direction hints for four seconds. No slowing.

classRecipes.label: Light carrier
classRecipes.description: Pick up one charge at a supply pad; drop a field that stuns nearby field enemies.

classRecipes.label: Heavy carrier
classRecipes.description: Carry two charges; each creates the same temporary stun field.

classRecipes.label: Interceptor
classRecipes.description: Absorb one enemy or lane contact: cancel the cut and recover at spawn without losing a life. Self-crossing remains dangerous.

classRecipes.label: Fiber relay
classRecipes.description: Ignore signal interference and scan for hidden relays. Your cable is the live trail: enemy contact still breaks it.

classRecipes.label: Impact craft
classRecipes.description: Release a close-range stun pulse, abandon the unfinished cut and redeploy at home without losing a life. The pulse never captures territory.

classRecipes.label: Trapper
classRecipes.description: Pick up one charge and place a four-second field that slows field enemies to one quarter speed.
